title: intent upgrade writes an empty intent/events.jsonl into the tree: migrate re-emits canon through export's canon parts, which still name the retired single-file form; the pointer scan lists records and rendered views
body:
Found by cc on 2026-09-18 landing Intent's own estate commit (e06e94d2b) on the f4c8a5b2e pair: `intent upgrade` wrote an empty `intent/events.jsonl` into the tree, 0 bytes, untracked, and cc removed it rather than commit it. Reproduced by vc in a scratch clone of e06e94d2b under an isolated home, and again on the convergent re-run of the same verb.

Cause, traced in the source: `migrate.rs` passes an empty event list into the bundle and writes every part `export::canon_parts` returns, and `canon_parts` (`export.rs`) pushes `(events.jsonl, to_jsonl(events))` as its last part, so the retired single-file form lands at `intent/events.jsonl` with nothing in it. Until ST0078 P1 the `.gitignore` rule for that path hid the file; P1 retired the rule because the event log now travels as one committed file per event under `intent/.canon/events/` (D53 reversed), so the file shows as untracked in every estate the verb touches. The fleet trawl runs `intent upgrade` on every estate and would either carry the empty file into every estate commit or remove it by hand in each, so this blocks pristine and lands before the trawl and before the 3.1.0 tag.

In the same verb's output, a second thing worth one fix in the same bank: the v2 bucket-path pointer scan (`legacy::pointers`) lists files under `intent/.canon/events/` and the whiteboard's rendered views (`board.json`, `wip.md`, `inbox.<sender>.md`) as authored files naming a bucket path, to read and reword by hand. They are records and generated views, and the store renders the views, so the worklist asks for an edit doctor would report as skew. The scan already skips the leftovers themselves and anything under a `.history/` for the same reason (issue 0364); `.canon/` and the rendered whiteboard views belong on that exclusion, and a node's authored scripts under `intent/whiteboard/<node>/` stay listed.

Fix, ruled by vc under the pen: no act other than `intent export` produces `events.jsonl`; `canon_parts` stops emitting it and the export document projections that carry the single-file form add it in their own projection, so migrate's re-emission writes canon only. The arm that proves it drives the real `intent upgrade` on a migrated estate and asserts no `intent/events.jsonl` afterwards, beside the existing arm in `the_event_log_travels.rs` that asserts the ignore rule is gone. The pointer scan gains the two exclusions with the existing pointers arm extended by a record under `.canon/events/` and a `board.json` naming a bucket path, neither listed.
